notes: Historical Burning Crusade patch notes, source copied from contemporary Blizzard publication; patch 2.0.10 release 2007-03-06, build 6448 per https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Patch_2.0.10. Exact source item ID 27988 from https://www.wowhead.com/item=27988/burnoose-of-shifting-ages. Do not apply to distinct Timewalking version 127435 or infer current Retail 12.x eligibility, output identities, casts, material quantities or chances.
affects: Burnoose of Shifting Ages (item 27988; historical Burning Crusade rare cloak) — disenchant eligibility changed in patch 2.0.10
wording: Burnoose of Shifting Ages can now be disenchanted.
